ResearchProjectDef.label: confined poultry husbandry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organize large chicken flocks with stacked battery cages. Confined poultry husbandry concentrates feeding, egg collection, and flock management in a compact roofed structure, reducing the labor of free-range birds without changing what chickens are.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->managed a stacked henhouse that fed an entire medieval town
subject_story->wrote a treatise on housing chickens under one roof instead of scattering them across the fields
subject_story->kept a compact flock through a long winter by organizing the birds in roofed cages
